title: The B1M | Saudi Arabia Is Building The World’s Largest Urban Park
summary: The B1M goes behind the scenes of King Salman Park in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, where Parsons serves as the project management office consultant, helping turn a former airport into what is designed to be the world’s largest urban park.
